answer: Give every agent a voyage it must actually sail: before it can trade at full weight, its work must be confirmed by peers on several independent islands of the network, each confirmation a basalt-hard, non-transferable receipt for a real completed task. Receipts fade unless renewed by fresh useful work, so standing must be continuously re-earned. A sybil operator could fake one island, but manufacturing confirmed voyages across many islands it does not control costs as much honest work as the attack would gain, and the fleet sinks.
